# Desencriptar HumanID
**API path(s):** /v2/human-id/decrypt

## Respuesta

```json
{
  "data": {
    "identifier": "613375a1eab2fe08527f81e2_zk_randomid_93558",
    "metadata": {
      "secretB": "4",
      "secretA": "3"
    },
    "publicData": {
      "b": "2",
      "a": "1",
      "vida": "true"
    },
    "faceCropBase64": "",
    "difficulty": "EASY"
  },
  "credits": null,
  "charged": false,
  "requiredLiveness": false
}
```
